headline: Govt to recruit 100,000 health workers and 25,000 midwives
summary: The Bangladesh government is set to significantly expand its healthcare workforce to improve medical services across the country.
details: The Bangladesh government has announced plans to recruit 100,000 health workers and 25,000 midwives to strengthen the national healthcare system.
This massive recruitment drive is aimed at improving access to medical care and ensuring better health services for citizens, particularly in rural areas.
The addition of 25,000 midwives will specifically target maternal and newborn health, reducing mortality rates and safer deliveries.
The initiative is part of a broader strategy to enhance the capacity of the healthcare infrastructure and provide more professional support to existing medical staff.
caption:
125,000 new positions in the health sector! The government is launching a massive recruitment drive.

The Bangladesh government has announced plans to recruit 100,000 health workers and 25,000 midwives to strengthen the national healthcare system.

This massive recruitment drive is aimed at improving access to medical care and ensuring better health services for citizens, particularly in rural areas.

The addition of 25,000 midwives will specifically target maternal and newborn health, reducing mortality rates and safer deliveries.

The initiative is part of a broader strategy to enhance the capacity of the healthcare infrastructure and provide more professional support to existing medical staff.

headline_marked: Rainfall to [[intensify across country]] by week's end
headline: Rainfall to intensify across country by week's end
summary: Heavy rain and thunderstorms with winds up to 60 kmph are expected in Dhaka and 14 other districts.
details: The weather forecast indicates that rainfall will intensify across Bangladesh by the end of the week. This increase in precipitation is attributed to the active monsoon winds affecting the region.
In the short term, thunderstorms accompanied by wind speeds of up to 60 kmph are expected to hit Dhaka and 14 other districts by noon.
Additionally, there is a risk of very heavy rainfall in three divisions over the next two days, as the monsoon winds remain active.
Residents are advised to stay alert as the weather conditions are expected to worsen towards the end of the week.
caption:
